title: One of the main locations in my dreams is the Akron Zoo.
content: I've been to Akron Zoo alot in the awaken world, and I've been to alot of recurring exhibits in my dream version of Akron Zoo that have appeared in my dreams. I've been to other zoos like Cincinnati in my dreams, but Akron is the most common. Here are the locations: The Bear Exhibit: One of the most common locations. Unlike the one in the woken world, it features a pathway made of wood with glass barriers. There is occasionally a wooden hut to see more of the bears. The Primate and Aquatics building: This has appeared alot in my dreams. The building's roof is colored blue. The building houses many species but the only one I can remember is the capybara. I remember first dreaming about it when the capybaras in the woken Akron Zoo have been moved. In that dream, It got its grand opening. Australia Exhibit: This one features a few Aviaries for cockatoos and lorikeets. I dont know if there was a kangaroo exhibit was there, but i know it featuring a few aviaries like the ones you'll find in old zoos. Aquarium: The latest exhibit featured in my dream. Sadly, it was closed but outside were exhibits on the shores of Lake Erie that talked about beach conservation.
